digitalFoundation.name: Digital Foundation
digitalFoundation.summary: Website, domain, email, Google Business Profile, social profiles and analytics — set up properly from day one.
digitalFoundation.heroTitle: A professional digital foundation from day one
digitalFoundation.heroSubtitle: We set up the essentials every business needs to look credible, be found and communicate professionally.
digitalFoundation.problem: New and growing businesses often end up with a patchwork: a website built by one person, email set up by another, and nobody who knows where the domain is registered.
digitalFoundation.solution: We plan and set up your core digital presence as one coherent foundation, document every account and keep ownership in your company's name.
whoFor: Newly registered companies
Businesses without a website or with an outdated one
Companies still using personal email addresses
Local businesses that want to be found online
deliverables: Domain, DNS and hosting configured in your name
Google Business Profile and social profiles set up
Analytics and basic SEO in place
A handover document listing every account
digitalFoundation.longTerm: After launch we can keep your foundation maintained, secure and up to date as part of ongoing digital operations.

faq.q: Do we own the website and domain?
faq.a: Yes. Domains and accounts are registered to your company, and we document all access.

faq.q: Can you work with our existing website?
faq.a: Yes. We review what you have first and only rebuild when it genuinely makes sense.

faq.q: How long does a typical setup take?
faq.a: It depends on scope. A focused foundation is often ready within a few weeks; we agree a timeline before we start.

digitalOperations.name: Ongoing Digital Operations
digitalOperations.tagline: We continuously maintain and operate it.
digitalOperations.summary: Maintenance, content updates, SEO and social media support, technical upkeep and digital asset management.
digitalOperations.heroTitle: Your digital side, maintained every month
digitalOperations.heroSubtitle: A website is not a one-time project. We keep everything running, updated and secure — so you don't have to think about it.
digitalOperations.problem: Websites go stale, plugins break, logins get lost and small updates wait for weeks because nobody owns them.
digitalOperations.solution: We act as your ongoing digital operations team: one place to send requests, with regular maintenance and clear reporting.
whoFor: Businesses with a website but no one to maintain it
Teams that want one point of contact for digital requests
Companies that need regular content or SEO updates
Growing businesses with several digital tools to look after
deliverables: Regular updates, backups and security checks
Content and page updates on request
Monitoring of uptime and key accounts
A shared request and ticket overview in your client portal
digitalOperations.longTerm: Operations is where the partnership lives — we learn your business and handle the digital side as it changes.

faq.a: Through your client portal: requests, tickets and direct messages to our team.

faq.q: Do you support websites you didn't build?
faq.a: Usually yes, after an initial technical review.

faq.q: Is this a fixed monthly service?
faq.a: We agree a scope that fits your needs — from light maintenance to broader operations support.

businessSystems.name: Business Systems
businessSystems.tagline: We build the tools your business needs.
businessSystems.summary: CRM, inventory and order management, dashboards, reporting, data management and internal tools.
businessSystems.heroTitle: Systems that fit how your business actually works
businessSystems.heroSubtitle: From a simple CRM to custom internal tools — we design, configure or build the systems that remove manual work.
businessSystems.problem: Many businesses run on spreadsheets, email threads and disconnected tools, which makes reporting slow and mistakes common.
businessSystems.solution: We map your workflows first, then configure existing tools or build focused internal systems — keeping them simple and maintainable.
whoFor: Businesses outgrowing spreadsheets
Teams that need a shared view of customers or orders
Owners who want reliable numbers without manual work
Companies with repetitive internal processes
deliverables: CRM, inventory or order management setup
Dashboards and reports for key numbers
Custom internal tools where off-the-shelf doesn't fit
businessSystems.longTerm: Systems need care as the business changes. We maintain, extend and improve them over time.

faq.q: Do you always build custom software?
faq.a: No. We prefer proven existing tools and only build custom when it clearly pays off.

faq.q: Can you connect our existing tools?
faq.a: Often yes — through integrations, APIs or automation, depending on the tools.
You do. We design systems so data stays accessible and exportable.

growthVisibility.tagline: We help improve visibility and digital performance.
growthVisibility.summary: SEO, local SEO, content, digital marketing and ads support, conversion optimisation and lead generation systems.
growthVisibility.heroTitle: Be found by the customers who are looking for you
growthVisibility.heroSubtitle: Practical, measurable support to improve how your business shows up online and converts visitors into enquiries.
growthVisibility.problem: A website alone doesn't bring customers. Without search visibility, content and a clear path to contact, good businesses stay invisible.
growthVisibility.solution: We focus on the fundamentals that matter for your market — search, local presence, content and conversion — and coordinate specialists for advanced campaigns.
whoFor: Local businesses that want more enquiries

Teams without in-house marketing capacity
deliverables: Google Ads support with specialist coordination
growthVisibility.longTerm: Visibility compounds over time. We keep improving step by step and report honestly on results.

faq.a: No one can honestly guarantee rankings. We focus on proven fundamentals and transparent reporting.
We support Google Ads setup and management, and bring in specialist partners for larger campaigns.
We agree a few meaningful metrics upfront — such as enquiries, visibility and traffic — and report on them.

peopleRecruitment.name: People & Recruitment
peopleRecruitment.tagline: We support hiring and HR operations.
peopleRecruitment.summary: Recruitment support, candidate sourcing, technical recruitment, HR administration, onboarding and HR data.
peopleRecruitment.heroTitle: Support for hiring and HR operations
peopleRecruitment.heroSubtitle: Structured recruitment and HR administration support for businesses that are growing their team.
peopleRecruitment.problem: Hiring takes time owners don't have, and HR administration often lives in scattered documents and inboxes.
peopleRecruitment.solution: We support your hiring process end to end — from job posts and sourcing to onboarding — and set up simple HR workflows. Specialist recruiters are coordinated where needed.

peopleRecruitment.longTerm: As your team grows, we keep recruitment and HR administration organised and running smoothly.

faq.a: We provide recruitment support and coordination as part of your operations, and work with specialist partners where needed.

faq.q: Do you provide employment law advice?

faq.q: Can you set up employee accounts too?

automationAi.name: Automation & AI
automationAi.summary: Business and workflow automation, AI-assisted workflows, reporting and CRM automation, internal tools.
automationAi.heroTitle: Less repetitive work, more time for the business
automationAi.heroSubtitle: We identify repetitive tasks and automate them with reliable tools — using AI where it genuinely helps.
automationAi.problem: Copying data between systems, sending the same reminders and building the same reports every week costs hours.
automationAi.solution: We look for the processes with the highest manual effort, automate them step by step and keep a human in control where it matters.
whoFor: Teams doing the same manual tasks every week
Businesses with data spread across several tools
Owners who want reports without spreadsheets
Companies curious about practical AI use
automationAi.longTerm: Automations need monitoring as tools change. We keep them working and look for the next improvement.

faq.a: No. Many valuable automations are simple and rule-based. We use AI only where it adds real value.
We design automations with data minimisation and access control in mind, and agree what data can be processed.

faq.q: What does a first automation look like?
faq.a: Often something small and frequent — like reminders, data entry or a weekly report.

howWeWork.title: Five steps to a digital side that runs itself
howWeWork.subtitle: We don't hand over a project and disappear. We stay, operate and improve — as your external digital operations team.

details.understand: A structured conversation about your business, customers, tools and priorities. We review your current setup and agree what matters most.
details.build: We set up or fix the essentials — website, accounts, email, systems — and document everything in your company's name.
details.operate: Ongoing maintenance, updates and support. You send requests through your client portal; we handle them.
details.improve: We regularly look for repetitive work, weak spots and quick wins, and suggest practical improvements.
details.scale: As you grow, we extend systems, support hiring and add capabilities — with specialist partners where it makes sense.

howWeWork.partnershipText: Our core team handles the digital operations directly. For specialist work — such as advanced legal, accounting or large paid-media campaigns — we coordinate vetted partners so you still have one point of contact.

monthly.title: Monthly Partnership
monthly.subtitle: Ongoing digital and operational support for a predictable monthly fee — one team that knows your business and keeps the digital side running.

sections.title: What a monthly partnership means
sections.text: Instead of starting a new project every time something needs doing, you work with ExploreTechify on an ongoing basis. We agree a monthly scope together and handle the agreed work each month as one accountable team.

sections.title: Typical ongoing support
items: Website updates, content changes and maintenance
SEO and digital presence follow-up
Business email, accounts and user administration
CRM and business-system support
Recruitment and HR administration support
Automation improvements and technical support
Regular reporting on the work done

sections.title: Scope, responsibilities, priorities and communication
sections.text: Before we start, we agree in writing what the monthly scope covers, who is responsible for what on each side, how priorities are set, and how and how often we communicate. Requests outside the agreed scope are discussed with you before any extra work begins.

sections.title: Monthly fee and billing
sections.text: The monthly fee is based on the agreed scope and set out in a written proposal before work begins. There is no standard price list — the fee, billing schedule and payment terms are agreed with you individually.

sections.title: Adjusting as your business changes
sections.text: Your needs will change over time. The scope can be reviewed together at agreed intervals and adjusted up or down, with any change to the scope or fee agreed in writing.

monthly.ctaText: Tell us what you need help with today. We'll suggest a practical monthly scope — no obligation.

growth.title: Growth Partnership
growth.subtitle: A selective partnership where we contribute to business growth under a separately negotiated agreement.

sections.title: The purpose of a growth partnership
sections.text: Some businesses have strong potential but need more than a supplier to realise it. In selected cases, ExploreTechify can take a more committed role and work alongside the owners towards shared growth objectives.

sections.title: What we can contribute
items: Technical development and digital systems
Digital presence, marketing support and SEO
Operational structure, processes and automation
Business-building support such as recruitment and reporting

sections.title: Opportunities are evaluated individually
sections.text: A Growth Partnership is not a standard package and is not available to every client. Each opportunity is assessed on its own merits — the business, its plans, the people involved and whether there is a good fit. Starting a project with us does not in itself create a partnership.

sections.title: Possible structures
sections.text: If a partnership is agreed, its structure is negotiated separately. Each option has different legal, tax and commercial implications.

structures.title: Profit-sharing
structures.text: We receive an agreed share of the profit or revenue from a defined activity for an agreed period. This is a contractual arrangement — it does not give us ownership of the business.

structures.title: Equity / shareholding
structures.text: We become a shareholder by acquiring shares in the company. This involves ownership rights and obligations and requires valuation, company documentation and compliance with applicable company law.

structures.title: Hybrid arrangement
structures.text: A combination — for example a reduced fee together with profit-sharing or equity. Each element is defined and documented separately.

sections.title: Important to know
items: No equity, investment or profit-sharing arrangement is guaranteed.
ExploreTechify does not automatically invest in a client's business, and does not automatically receive shares by starting a project.
Responsibilities, valuation, ownership, decision-making, risk and other terms require separate due diligence and written agreements where applicable.
We recommend that both parties take independent legal and financial advice.

growth.ctaTitle: Think there could be a fit?
growth.ctaText: Tell us about your business and where you want to take it. We'll be honest about whether a growth partnership makes sense.

project.title: Task-Based Engagement
project.subtitle: Hire us for a clearly defined task or project with an agreed scope, price and delivery plan.

sections.title: Requesting a task or project
sections.text: Tell us what you need — for example a new website, a specific integration, an automation or a one-off setup. Share the context you have; a short description is enough to start.

sections.title: Defining requirements and deliverables
sections.text: We review your request, ask clarifying questions and, where needed, arrange a short call. Together we define the requirements, what will be delivered and what is outside the scope.

sections.title: Quote, scope and timeline
sections.text: You receive a written proposal with the agreed scope, price and an estimated timeline. Work starts only once you have accepted it.

sections.title: Milestones and review
sections.text: Where appropriate, larger projects are split into milestones. You review each milestone before we move on, so your feedback is built into the delivery.

sections.title: Payment arrangements
sections.text: Payment terms — for example an upfront portion, payment per milestone or payment on delivery — are agreed for each project before work begins. There is no single payment policy for all projects.

project.ctaTitle: Have a task or project in mind?
project.ctaText: Send us a short description. We'll reply with questions or a suggested next step.
